Prism.//ManagedIdentityClientId: Client id of id-prism-platform (the user-assigned MI). Leave null locally to use `az login`.
Prism.//ExpandAllInstalls: Per-device install lists for the whole detected-app inventory (not just InstallVisibilityPatterns), most-installed first, capped at MaxInstallExpansions Graph calls per run.
Prism.//ExpandInstallsDayOfWeek: Empty = every run. Set 'Sunday' for a weekly full sweep; other days skip the phase and keep the previous snapshot.
Prism.//CostManagementScope: Scope for the cost connector, e.g. tenant-root MG: /providers/Microsoft.Management/managementGroups/<tenant-guid>. Empty = skip.
Prism.//CostColumn: PreTaxCost for EA / management-group scopes; Cost for an MCA subscription scope.
Prism.//Sink: file = NDJSON under LandingDirectory (dev); sql = Azure SQL warehouse (prod).
Prism.//ConnectionString: Required when Sink=sql. Secret-free Entra auth.
Prism.//Pricing: Loads ref.SkuCost from the negotiated Price Sheet API. Leave BillingAccountName null to skip and maintain prices manually. See PRICING.md.
Prism.//Defender: Optional shadow-IT discovery via Defender for Cloud Apps (FIC -> MI -> Prism-DfCAConnector app). Disabled unless EnableDefenderConnector and the base URL/tenant/app are set.
Prism.//Enabled: Connectors to run by name (e.g. ["intune.devices"]). Empty = run all.
Prism.//v2Signals: New signal connectors, all off by default. mailboxsettings needs MailboxSettings.Read; pstn needs CallRecord-PstnCalls.Read.All; authmethods reuses AuditLog.Read.All.
Prism.//MaxConcurrentConnectors: Connectors run concurrently up to this bound (1 = strictly sequential). Graph throttles per app+tenant, so keep it modest.
